other_failure_modes.name: Test-batch dependent feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Computing group statistics (like mean or std) on the test set directly instead of mapping them from the training set. This causes test predictions to depend on the other samples in the test batch, and will produce NaNs or zeros if the test batch is small (e.g., 1 sample).

other_failure_modes.name: Optimistic CV score via global OOF optimization
other_failure_modes.description: Optimizing ensemble weights and classification thresholds on the entire out-of-fold dataset at once, and then reporting the final CV score on this exact same dataset. This leaks information across folds and results in an optimistically biased CV score.

summary: The agent provides an exceptionally strong and well-structured solution. It correctly frames the ordinal classification task as a regression problem with threshold optimization, leverages the auxiliary continuous target, and uses a robust 5-fold cross-validation setup with an ensemble of GBDTs and a PyTorch neural network. The only notable flaws are a test-batch dependency in the group-based feature engineering (which could break inference on single test samples) and a minor optimistic bias in the final CV score due to optimizing thresholds globally on the OOF predictions.
